summary: #1512: targeted mailbox notifications and safety rechecks

replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged targeted mailbox notifications and safety rechecks change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in targeted mailbox notifications and safety rechecks; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Mailbox streams route notifications by dependencies and run independent full safety reads every 30 seconds. The dispatcher is disposable in-memory state; frame, claim, incarnation and epoch contracts remain unchanged. Dispatcher errors appear in the local mailbox-wake-dispatcher doctor check, retry every five seconds, and leave safety reads active.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by targeted mailbox notifications and safety rechecks; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by targeted mailbox notifications and safety rechecks.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
